name: thatseoagent
description: Build tooling for the ThatSeoAgent admin screen. The compiled CSS is committed; installing the plugin needs no Node.
author: Angel Cruz <angel.cruz@wallbit.io>

scripts.vendor:fonts: mkdir -p assets/fonts && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk/files/space-grotesk-latin-wght-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk/files/space-grotesk-latin-ext-wght-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/space-mono/files/space-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/space-mono/files/space-mono-latin-700-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/space-mono/files/space-mono-latin-ext-400-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/space-mono/files/space-mono-latin-ext-700-normal.woff2 assets/fonts/ && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk/LICENSE assets/fonts/SPACE-GROTESK-LICENSE.txt && cp node_modules/@fontsource/space-mono/LICENSE assets/fonts/SPACE-MONO-LICENSE.txt
scripts.build: pnpm run vendor:alpine && pnpm run vendor:fonts && pnpm run build:css
